2610.12163.title: Scalable Hierarchical Graph Generation via Soft Community Structure
2610.12163.paper_summary: Generating large attributed graphs requires reproducing the topology, generating attributes jointly with the structure, and remaining scalable. Many real-world graphs exist as a single large graph, so a generative model has to generalize from the one graph it is fit on, without independent samples. We present Schema, which recursively decomposes a reference graph into a hierarchy of soft communities, assigning each node a membership distribution. Generation is then split into three stages, each trained independently: (1) synthesizing node attributes conditioned on soft memberships, (2) generating intra-community edges from local structural context, and (3) modeling inter-community connections over bridge nodes whose membership mass is distributed across several communities. No stage forms the full adjacency matrix, and each stage operates on a subgraph bounded by the community size. We also introduce an evaluation protocol that covers structural fidelity, memorization, downstream utility, and scalability. On four real-world attributed graphs, Schema recovers the balance between local and long-range structure more closely than any other model that generates attributes, while reproducing only a small fraction of the reference edges. It retains the downstream accuracy of the reference graph without raising it artificially above that level. Baselines that match its structural fidelity memorize the reference, while those with higher downstream accuracy either exceed the reference accuracy or fail to complete on the larger graphs. We measure scalability on six additional graphs with up to 10 million nodes.
2610.12163.paper_summary_zh: 生成大型屬性圖需要重現拓撲結構，與結構共同生成屬性，並保持可擴展性。許多現實世界的圖存在為一個大型圖，因此生成模型必須從其擬合的單一圖中進行概括，而沒有獨立的樣本。我們提出了 Schema，它將參考圖遞歸地分解為一個軟社群的層次結構，並為每個節點分配一個成員分佈。生成過程分為三個階段，每個階段獨立訓練：（1）根據軟成員資格合成節點屬性，（2）從局部結構上下文生成社群內邊緣，以及（3）建模跨社群連接，這些連接通過其成員質量分佈在多個社群中的橋接節點。沒有一個階段形成完整的鄰接矩陣，每個階段在由社群大小界定的子圖上運作。我們還介紹了一個評估協議，涵蓋結構保真度、記憶化、下游效用和可擴展性。在四個現實世界的屬性圖上，Schema 更接近於恢復局部和長距結構之間的平衡，超過了任何其他生成屬性的模型，同時僅重現參考邊緣的一小部分。它保持了參考圖的下游準確性，而不會人為地提高到那個水平。與其結構保真度相匹配的基準會記住參考，而那些具有更高下游準確性的基準要麼超過參考準確性，要麼無法在較大的圖上完成。我們在六個額外的圖上測量可擴展性，這些圖的節點數量高達 1000 萬。
